caption: The drawing depicts a single cream-colored pottery jug with a slightly curved, bulbous body and a narrow, slightly flared neck. The jug is decorated with a blue floral pattern consisting of a stem, leaves, and a flower or bud on the front, as well as a smaller blue leaf and flower detail near the neck. The background is plain and unadorned, with the jug centered on the page. There is a small red asterisk and the initials “M.A.R.S.” written near the bottom right of the jug. The overall composition is simple, with the jug as the only object and no additional elements present in the drawing.
title: Stoneware Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
